repair.title: Landmine Stockpiles Shrank
repair.summary: Landmine Monitor reports that 94 Mine Ban Treaty states have destroyed more than 55 million stockpiled antipersonnel mines.
repair.why_it_matters: Destroying stockpiles removes weapons designed to keep harming civilians long after fighting ends.
repair.caveat: Landmines are still being used, and casualties have recently risen in some conflicts.
